verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents S3-compatible AI Object Storage with efficient direct-to-GPU access, plus supporting tooling like token-exchange credentials, Cloud Console object browsing, lifecycle policies, conditional writes, and a Local Object Transport Accelerator for fast transfers, alongside Terraform IaC for buckets/policies. Missing for 10: dedicated cloud-to-cloud sync tooling (e.g., rclone/DataSync-style integrations) and independent hands-on benchmarks of transfer throughput.
